# ML/MIL

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [Blob.h](Blob.h): MILBlob's storage format, version 2, as the phase 0 spike found Core ML accepts it: a 64-byte header, then per entry a 64-byte metadata record on a 64-byte boundary with the data right after it. (declares `DataType`, `Writer`)
- [Half.h](Half.h): IEEE binary16 bits, rounded to nearest even: the form every fp16 tensor takes in the weight blob and every fp16 scalar takes inline. (declares `floatToHalf`, `halfToFloat`, `appendHalf`, `halfBytes`)
- [MILWriter.h](MILWriter.h): declares `DataType`, `sizeOf`, `toText`, `TensorType`, `Floats`, `Ints`, `Bools`, `StringList`, `RawBytes`, `ImmediateValue`, `BlobFileValue`, `Value`, `NamedValueType`, `Input`, `Attribute`, `Operation`, `Block`, `Function`, `Program`, `ArrayDataType`, `ArrayFeature`, `Description`, `Specification`, `encode`, `serialize`
- [Package.h](Package.h): A written .mlpackage, as bytes: Data/com.apple.CoreML/model.mlmodel (the Model.proto), Data/com.apple.CoreML/weights/weight.bin (the MILBlob, absent when the program has no tensor constants) and Manifest.json, whose identifiers are fixed so a package's bytes are a function of its graph. (declares `Package`)
- [Protobuf.h](Protobuf.h): declares `Bytes`, `asBytes`, `WireType`, `Writer`
